findings.issue: תּוֹרַת is a common noun (H8451, feminine singular construct); torá leaves that lemma untranslated.
הַשֹּׁרֶצֶת (H8317, qal active participle: wriggle/swarm/abound) is the same reptante as הָרֹמֶשֶׂת (H7430, creep/glide), so the swarm/abound sense is omitted.
The first נֶפֶשׁ is construct before the definite adjective הַחַיָּה; alma la viva leaves that construct link unstated.

notes: The failing la reptante is the one before sobre la tierra; the earlier reptante matches H7430.
